title: fix: C_DestroyObject allows cross-slot object destruction
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c, C_DestroyObject validates the session handle and the object handle but does NOT verify that the object's slot_id matches the session's slot_id. An object created via a session on slot 0 (soft token) can be destroyed using a session on slot 1 (USB token).

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.10 implies objects are scoped to their token. Cross-slot destruction violates this scope.

Trigger: Open session on slot 0, create object (gets handle H). Open session on slot 1. Call C_DestroyObject(slot1_session, H). Object on slot 0 is destroyed.

Fix: In C_DestroyObject, after fetching the object via handle, check: if (obj->slot_id != session_get(hSession)->slot_id) return CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID;
